integrity: An exact analytic reduction and invariant-tube argument establish the claim; numerical integration and symbolic checks are secondary. Independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Local near-extinction theorem on the critical invasion slice, with bounded near-nullcline initial data; compact-positive-scaled-time convergence. No global-basin or stochastic extinction result.
title: Universal quadratic-to-cubic extinction crossover in a nonlinear-dispersal two-patch Allee model
